title: Chapter 264 - 264 Confession; End!

Chapter 264 - 264 Confession; End!

Chapter 264 - 264 Confession; End!

264 Confession; End!

Ling Rou had a good voice and was very hardworking. She sang hard every day.

Today… her hard work over the years had finally paid off.

At the end of each song, the live audience would give a round of applause.

In the blink of an eye, she had sung more than ten songs.

The atmosphere at the scene did not slow down even though time had passed.

On the contrary, it became even more enthusiastic.

Everyone’s faces were filled with enjoyment and excitement, and their bodies could not help but sway along with the music.

Ling Rou picked up the microphone again and said, “I’ve always had a dream, and that was to hold a concert of my own.

“But I understood that dreams were just dreams. Most of the time, they can only appear in dreams.

“And today, someone helped me realize it!

“I wish to thank him!

“I don’t know how long I have left in this life, but I know that he’s definitely the most important person in my life!”

As she said this, Ling Rou’s gaze was fixed on Lin Fan.

As soon as she said this, the crowd immediately erupted into an uproar. Many of the audience members exclaimed loudly.

“Heavens, isn’t this too romantic?”

“Ling Rou, you’re the best!”

“Is this a confession? No!”

…

VIP 1.

Hu Tian, Qiu Ziqian, Chu Yunyue, Huang Ling, Han Tian, and the other women all looked at Lin Fan with smiles.

That appearance… It was as if they were saying, “Are still gonna say that she’s not our sister?”

Lin Fan did not expect Ling Rou to say something like that. He rubbed his nose. He was too charming.

…

As soon as Ling Rou finished speaking, pleasant music immediately sounded in the venue.

Although the audience was still a little excited because of Ling Rou’s words, after the music started, they could not help but quieten down.

They were all looking forward to it… They were looking forward to Ling Rou’s beautiful singing!

At this moment, Ling Rou finally opened her willow-shaped red lips slowly.

“It’s a clear and cloudless night. A full moon hangs in the sky. Her long clothes dance in the wind. She’s as soft as feathers, as light as a swan, and as fair as jade…”

If the previous Sword Dance had brought the audience into the world of chivalrous righteousness and lofty sentiments, then Galaxy brought the audience into the world of immortals and heroes.

As the song rang out, they seemed to see Ling Rou move mountains and fill the sea, exterminate demons and devils, and finally leap into the vast starry sky.

The sun and moon revolved above Ling Rou’s head, and the stars spun around her body. It was extremely magical.

She… She was the only fairy in the world!

In the next moment…

She raised her hand and formed a rainbow sword. She slashed at the endless void. The terrifying sword light formed a storm that covered the sky and the sun, causing all chaos and the universe to shatter like bubbles. The most dazzling fireworks in the world bloomed.

“In the end, I split apart the chaos and the universe with a single sword strike!”

The music gradually stopped and the song ended.

Silence.

The entire place was silent at first.

Everyone was shocked by this song.

After a while, someone gradually came back to their senses and started clapping.

Then, everyone applauded.

The applause shook the sky like thunder!

Some people could not help but shout loudly.

“You sang so well!”

“It was so great!”

“This is definitely the best song I’ve ever heard!”

“Ling Rou, you’re the best!”

…

In fact…

It was not just the ordinary audience who was excited. Zhang Xiaohai, the deputy director of Gundong Entertainment, was also excited and shouted, “She sang these songs so well! Especially the last song, it was simply… It was like splitting the heavens and earth!

“It’s so good!”

Director Zhao Peng jumped up excitedly and shouted, “Beautiful appearance, excellent voice, strong creative ability, perfect stage performance… She’s definitely going to be a superstar in the future!

“No, I have to talk to her!”

Then, he hurried toward the stage.

However, there were many people who had similar thoughts.

The security guards had already expected this situation and blocked the surroundings of the stage. How could they let anyone get close?

…

Ling Rou looked at the audience who were cheering for her crazily and was extremely excited. She bowed slightly and said, “Thank you for your applause, thank you!”

Then, she slowly descended from the stage that was several meters high.

At the same time, a voice rang out in the stadium.

“Today’s concert will end here. Please leave in order…”

However, the vast majority of people were still immersed in the beautiful song and did not have any thoughts of leaving.

…

VIP 1.

Hu Tian, Chu Yunyue, Huang Ling, Qiu Ziqian, Han Tian, and the others all looked at Lin Fan.

The looks on their faces… It was as if they were saying, ‘Why didn’t we know that you wrote such a good song?’

Lin Fan coughed lightly and said, “Writing songs is a very simple matter. That’s why I didn’t tell you guys.”

At this moment, a clear notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Mission completed—hold a concert with more than 100,000 spectators. You’ll receive ten silver packets.]

Mission accomplished!

Lin Fan was in a pretty good mood as well. His lips curled up slightly.

At this moment, Qiu Ziqian, who was sitting beside him, suggested, “Ling Rou must be very tired after singing on stage for so long. Let’s go and visit her.”

This sentence immediately gained the unanimous agreement of all the women.

Normal people could not get close to the stage, but Lin Fan and the others were not included in this group of people.

….

Xia Yan, like many others, was full of praise for Ling Rou’s singing.

She slowly stood up and muttered, “What a pity. If I had let my two obedient sisters learn to sing when they were young, they might be able to sing nice songs for me now.”

The next moment, her eyes that were looking straight ahead moved slightly as if she saw two familiar figures. She said in surprise, “Huh? Xia Bing, Xia Xue?”

However, by the time Xia Yan wanted to confirm it again, the two familiar figures had already been completely submerged in the sea of people.

Xia Yan could not help but shake her head. “It’s just my misconception. That’s right, they should still be studying seriously in school and preparing for the competition…

“They’re completely obsessed with Lin Fan…As a mother… As an elder sister, I can’t just watch them sink into oblivion. I have to save my good sisters.”

Xia Yan’s lips curled into a faint smile.
